fact: The DGI's Jibayatic platform lets taxpayers file declarations and pay taxes and duties online by bank transfer or CIB or Edahabia card, mandatory for large enterprises and optional for others, for taxes from electronic declarations only.
The General Directorate of Taxes launched Tabioucom for online payment of fiscal stamp duties by Edahabia or CIB card, initially for passport, national-ID and driving-licence applications.
source_slug: 2024-08-11 Algeria launches Tabioucom fiscal-stamp-duty e-payment platform

fact: Alger 16 reports online card payments in the first half of 2026 included AADL 3 housing instalments and Hajj fees, and administrative services made up 19% of online transactions.
The GIE Monetique director says electronic payment in the public sector is almost fully generalised, covering payment of taxes, bills, insurance, fees and administrative documents.
The Direction generale des impots announced the launch of electronic payment of duties and taxes online through the Jibayatic tele-declaration and tele-payment portal.
Algérie Éco, citing GIE Monétique, says many public administrations increasingly take electronic payment for their services, with 7.6 million online transactions for administrative services in 2025.
